description: This file defines data structures and enums related to the rebalancing process in Orleans, including the status of the rebalancer, a report structure for current rebalancing state, and statistics for diagnostics.

classes.name: RebalancerStatus
classes.description: Enum representing the status of the activation rebalancer, either executing or suspended.

classes.name: RebalancingReport
classes.description: Immutable struct providing a report on the current state of the rebalancer, including host silo, status, suspension duration, cluster imbalance, and statistics.

classes.name: RebalancingStatistics
classes.description: Immutable struct containing diagnostic metrics for a specific silo, including timestamp, silo address, dispersed activations, and acquired activations.
